subject: Moog
text: The Moog condition cannot be cured even with the Moogle Item, but asking the Chocobo for a ride and then asking again removes the condition.

evidence.quote:
The Moogle (Moog) condition cannot be cured even with the Moogle Item...First, 
ASK your Chocobo for a ride!...And then, ASK 
again and your Moog condition will be removed.

subject: Moog
text: Going back and forth between area edges or doorways uses up time to cure the Moog condition while preventing enemy contact.

evidence.quote:
Second, stay at the edge of the 
current area (in world map/field) or stay in front of the doorways (dungeons, 
towns, etc.) and go back and forth between this area and the other area. This 
will use the time and prevents enemy contact.

subject: Pois Condition
text: Moving back and forth between area edges or doorways will cure poison over time while limiting HP loss to at most 2 times.

evidence.quote:
Stay at the edge of the current area (in world map/field) or stay in 
front of the doorways (dungeons, towns, etc.) and go back and forth between 
this area and the other area. This will use up the time but will definitely 
cure Poison after a while. Doing this also lessens the effect of the poison. 
Your HP will drop at most 2 times only.

subject: Pois Condition
text: Asking the Heroine when she is with you counters the Pois effect by healing the exact amount of HP lost each time poison damages the character.

evidence.quote:
If the Heroine is with you, ASK her. This will 
counter the Pois effect. Every time Pois cuts down your HP, the heroine will 
heal that same amount of HP lost. Therefore, no change of HP will occur when 
in Pois Condition.

subject: Pois Condition
text: Hitting the A button rapidly makes the character attack continuously, which slows down the Pois condition and stops the depletion of HP.

evidence.quote:
Hitting the A button rapidly will make your 
character attack continuously. This will slow down the Pois condition. It will 
stop the depletion of your HP.

subject: Townspeople
text: People in towns can be killed in about 3-5 hits using strongest weapons, and they speak their lines afterwards.

evidence.quote:
In towns, YOU CAN KILL THE PEOPLE! Just be patient though. They have a high 
HP and won’t go down easily. When you use your strongest weapons, about 3-5 
hits will do. If you beat them, they will say their lines afterwards.

subject: Enemies
text: Leaving one enemy alive in an area causes enemies to respawn when leaving and returning.

evidence.quote:
But, if you left one of them, alive, and then came back again, the 
enemies will respawn. This is good for leveling up and collecting GPs.

subject: Cracked Wall
text: Striking a wall that produces a cranking sound indicates a Mattock or Morning Star can destroy that wall to reveal a new path.

evidence.quote:
When you strike a wall with a weapon and you hear a cranking sound, use 
your mattock or Morning Star to destroy that wall and reveal a new path.

subject: Empty Chest
text: An empty chest blocking the way can be destroyed with a weapon to make it disappear.

evidence.quote:
If an empty chest gets in your way, destroy it with your weapon and it will 
simply, disappear.

subject: Rocks
text: Standing between adjacent rocks and pressing the B button with a Mattock breaks 2 rocks in one shot, or they can be attacked head on with a Morning Star.

evidence.quote:
If there are a lot of rocks, and they are beside each other, you can break 
them in one shot. With the Mattock, stand in between the rocks and then press 
the B button. The 2 rocks will disappear. With the Morning Star, just attack 
the rocks head on.

subject: Mattock
text: All Mattocks can be sold once the Morning Star is acquired to free up item inventory space for items such as Keys.

evidence.quote:
Once you acquire the Morning Star, you won’t have any need for the 
Mattocks anymore. So, just sell ALL your mattocks to save space in the Items 
Inventory. This will enable you to get more important items such as Keys.

subject: Excalibur
text: The Excalibur sword is obtained automatically as one of the most powerful equipments in the game.

evidence.quote:
Here they are, the Excalibur (sword), Samurai Armor, Samurai Helmet and the 
Aegis Shield...Note: you’ll get the Excalibur automatically.

subject: Samurai Armor

subject: Julius
text: A level of at least Level 50 is recommended when battling Julius.

evidence.quote:
What level do you recommend should I be when I battle Julius?

You should be at least Level 50.

subject: Moog
text: Riding a Chocobo and jumping off again removes the Moog status.

evidence.quote:
Is there a way to cure Moog?

Yes. Ride your Chocobo and then jump off again. You’re Moog status should now 
be removed.

subject: Leveling Up
text: The best places to level up for experience points and GP are running back and forth defeating wolves, walruses, and Snowmen in the snowfield, or killing elephants near Julius.

evidence.quote:
I leveled up Sumo in 2 places. First, in the snowfield area. I kept running 
back and forth beating all those wolves, walruses, and Snowmen. The second one 
is near Julius. I kept on killing those elephants. Either way you’ll get good 
experience points and GP.

subject: Game Completion
text: Finishing the game with complete equipment and a high level takes about 10-12 hours.

evidence.quote:
In my opinion and in my experience, it will take you about 10-12 hours to 
finish the game with complete equipments and a high level.

subject: Level
text: The maximum attainable level is Level 99, with 999 HP and 99 MP.

evidence.quote:
What’s the max level that you can achieve?

Level 99. With 999 HP and 99 MP.
